# The EML save fix aligns message-window focus and mock arguments within its historical test phase

The older provisional note says "more than one compose window" and that the mock "must use the browsing context of the window that will open it." In this file the actual windows are message windows. The owned patch passes msgc/msgc2 browsing contexts to MockFilePicker.init and waits for msgc2 focus before its save shortcut. Accepted tests later use one setup-level mock and direct save commands while retaining the second-window focus wait. This replaces the automatic compose-window and universal-must interpretation only. It does not define a new global mock rule, infer mock ownership from its name or prove native interception/focus behavior. The original open_message_from_file helper already waits for message display and conditional window activation before returning; file1 does not gain a duplicate explicit focus wait.

Scope: browser-tests.
